lane:
وذب

وذاب وِذَابٌ The _stomach of a ruminant beast,_ (or, as in some lexicons, the _stomachs of such beasts,_ TA,) _with the intestines,_ or _guts, into which milk is put, and which are then cut in pieces,_ [_and eaten_]: a pl. which has no sing. (ISd, K.) === Also The _perforations,_ or _punctures, made in sewing,_ or the _loops,_ (the word in the original is خُرَبٌ, pl. of خُرَبْةٌ: in some of the lexicons, خُرَزٌ: but both these words relate to the same things: TA: [whence it appears that, accord. to the author of the TA, &c., the former of the above two meanings is the one intended:]) _of a_ مَزَادَة. (K.)

entries.text: وذب: الوِذابُ: خُرَبُ المَزادةِ، وَقِيلَ هِيَ الأَكراشُ الَّتِي يُجْعَلُ فِيهَا اللَّبَنُ ثُمَّ تُقْطَعُ. قَالَ ابْنُ سِيدَهْ: وَلَمْ أَسمع لَهَا بِوَاحِدٍ. قَالَ الأَفْوَهُ الأَوْديّ:|وَوَلَّوْا هارِبينَ بكُلِّ فَجٍّ، ... كأَنَّ خُصاهُمُ قِطَعُ الوِذابِ
